class.name: NNBTParallel
class.brief_description: Ticks all its enabled child nodes and combines their statuses. [code]RUNNING[/code] takes precedence over [code]FAILURE[/code], and [code]FAILURE[/code] takes precedence over [code]SUCCESS[/code].
class.description: The parallel node ticks all its enabled child nodes, regardless of child order. If any child returns [code]RUNNING[/code], the parallel node returns [code]RUNNING[/code]. Otherwise, if any child returns [code]FAILURE[/code], it returns [code]FAILURE[/code]. Otherwise it returns [code]SUCCESS[/code]. Disabled children are skipped.
